<BannerPreview />

##### Installation

<Code language="bash" code={`npx radianos add banner`} />

##### Imports

<Code language="tsx" code={`import {Alert} from "@/components/ui/alert"`} />

##### Props

| Prop Name | Default Values | Values                  |
| --------- | -------------- | ----------------------- |
| variant   | dark           | dark, transparent, soft |
| message   | false          | true/false              |
| children  | -              | -                       |

##### Usage

<Code
	language="tsx"
	code={`<Banner closable variant="dark" >
This is Banner Message
</Banner>`}
/>
